packs.name: TR-808 Recordings
packs.description: 116 one-shots recorded directly from a real Roland TR-808 (serial no. 103852) by Michael Fischer of Technopolis in 1994: 25 bass drums and 25 snares across the tone/decay and tone/snappy knobs, 25 cymbals, toms, congas, open hats and every other voice, each from its individual output at 16-bit/44.1 kHz. The '808 Classic' kit puts all 16 instruments on the pads; '808 Boom' keeps the essentials on bank A and plays the long-decay bass drum as a tuned 808 bass on bank B (C minor scale, pads choke each other). File names follow the original knob positions, e.g. bd0010 = tone 0, decay 10 (see README.md).
packs.author: Michael Fischer (Technopolis)
packs.attribution: TR-808 samples by Michael Fischer / Technopolis (1994), via tidalcycles/sounds-tr808-fischer (CC0 1.0).

packs.name: uzu Drumkit
packs.tagline: Punchy, analog-processed electronic drums from the TidalCycles community
packs.description: A small, carefully made electronic kit from the TidalCycles community: synthesized drums by Switch Angel run through an LA-76-style compressor, and modular-synth blips recorded by Ludens and Switch Angel. Kit A is a full electronic kit with alternate hats, kicks and percussion on bank B; Kit B swaps in alternate kicks and snares and puts the modular hits on pads 13–16. Not included: the upstream processed Amen break, the samples contributed by Mot4i (published elsewhere with an attribution request, not under the repo's Unlicense) and two unattributed acoustic files.
packs.author: Switch Angel and Ludens (TidalCycles community)
packs.attribution: uzu-drumkit by Switch Angel and Ludens, via tidalcycles/uzu-drumkit (The Unlicense / public domain).

packs.name: Sonic Pi Drums & Percussion
packs.tagline: Acoustic, electronic and tabla one-shots from Sonic Pi's CC0 library
packs.description: The drum and percussion part of the sample library that ships with Sonic Pi: an acoustic kit (kicks, snares, hats, cymbals and toms at two dynamics), 15 kicks, 22 hats, 4 snares, 25 electronic blips and hits, finger snaps and 26 tabla strokes. Collected from freesound.org and donated sounds, all dedicated to the public domain (CC0); the bundled README.md links every original. Four kits: Acoustic, Electro, Kick & Hat Lab (8 kicks on bank A, 8 hats on bank B) and Tabla.
packs.author: Sonic Pi project (sounds by freesound.org contributors)
packs.attribution: Samples from the Sonic Pi project (etc/samples), originally from freesound.org; CC0 1.0. Original links in README.md.

packs.name: FreePats Synth Percussion
packs.tagline: Vintage analog-synth style drums made with free software synths, CC0
packs.description: 21 drum sounds created by Roberto (FreePats project) with the Yoshimi and Geonkick software synthesizers as an approximation of drum sounds from vintage electronic music made with analog synths: kicks, snares, hats, claps, claves, toms, shakers and long cymbals. One 16-pad kit; the second take of each tom is in the folder for variation.
packs.author: Roberto (FreePats project)
packs.attribution: FreePats synthesizer percussion by Roberto <roberto@zenvoid.org> (CC0 1.0), freepats.zenvoid.org.
